dsDescriptionValue.value: Calcium imaging dataset of adherent cortical organoids at 2 developmental timepoints, using GCaMP6s delivered by AAV. Imaging performed with Zeiss LSM 800, and analysis using CNMF-E and Fluorosnapp and custom scripts.

publicationCitation.value: Kroeg, M. van der et al. Human adherent cortical organoids in a multiwell format. Elife 13, (2026).
